sn4.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Silāvatiyaṃ || || 2.
sn4.21:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato avidūre appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharanti || || 3.
sn4.21:1.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā brāhmaṇa-vaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantena jaṭaṇḍuvena ajinakkhipa-nivattho jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ghurughuru-passāsī udumbara-daṇḍaṃ gahetvā yena te bhikkhū ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca || ||
sn4.21:1.5: Daharā bhavanto pabbajitā susū kālakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā pathamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu || ||
sn4.21:1.7: mā sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikam anudhāvitthā ti || || 4.
sn4.21:1.8: Na kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikam hitvā kālikam anudhāvāma ||
sn4.21:1.9: kālikañ ca kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇa hitvā sandiṭṭhikam anudhāvāma || ||
sn4.21:1.10: Kālikā hi brāhmaṇa kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhīyo ||
sn4.21:1.11: sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī ti || || 5.
sn4.21:1.12: Evaṃ vutte Māro pāpimā sīsam okampetvā jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā tivisākhaṃ nalāṭena nalāṭikaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam olubbha pakkāmi || || 6.
sn4.21:2.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antam nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || 7.
sn4.21:2.2: Idha mayaṃ bhante Bhagavato avidūre appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharāma ||
sn4.21:2.3: Atha kho bhante aññataro brāhmaṇo mahantena jaṭaṇḍuvena ajinakkhipa-nivattho jiṇṇo gopānasivaṅko ghuru-ghuru-passāsī udumbaradaṇḍaṃ gahetvā yena amhe ten-upasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā amhe etad avoca || ||
sn4.21:2.4: Daharā bhavanto pabbajitā susū kālakesā bhadrena yobbanena samannāgatā pathamena vayasā anikīḷitāvino kāmesu || ||
sn4.21:2.6: mā sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikam anudhāvitthā ti || || 8.
sn4.21:2.7: Evaṃ vutte mayaṃ bhante taṃ brāhmaṇam etad' avocumha || ||
sn4.21:2.8: Na kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikam anudhāvāma ||
sn4.21:2.9: kālikaṃ ca kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇa hitvā sandiṭṭhikam anudhāvāma ||
sn4.21:2.10: kālikā hi brāhmaṇa kāmā vuttā Bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhīyo ||
sn4.21:2.11: sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattam veditabbo viññūhī ti || || 9.
sn4.21:2.12: Evaṃ vutte bhante so brāhmaṇo sīsam okampetvā jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā tivisākhaṃ nalāṭena nalāṭikaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam olubbha pakkanto ti || || 10.
sn4.21:3.2: Māro eso pāpimā tumhākaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgato ti || || 11.
sn4.21:3.3: Atha kho Bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
